newsitem.title: ITALY: Cir, Cofide hammered in Milan.
newsitem.headline: Cir, Cofide hammered in Milan.

text.p: Carlo De Benedetti's holding companies Cir and Cofide took a battering on the Milan stock exchange, both down some eight percent around day's lows.
Industrial holding Cir was off 7.52 percent at 620 lire at 1430 GMT after a low of 610 lire while financial holding Cofide was down 8.88 percent at a session low of 360 lire.

"After news Olivetti chief Francesco Caio is to be questioned by magistrates, worries have increased about balance sheet figures," one trader said. "And we don't yet know what the effects of the crisis at the group will have on jobs," he added.
